text: We're setting up a new location: the Indirect Material Inspection station.
One workbench, one material cart, one magnifying lamp, a notebook, and seats for one or two operators.
The bench is fifteen hundred fifty millimeters long, seven hundred fifty deep, and twenty-two hundred tall.
asr: The bench is 1550 mm long, 750 deep, and 2200 tall.

text: A blue, powder-coated steel frame carries a thirty millimeter worktop, with a white E S D dissipative laminate.
asr: A blue, powder-coated steel frame carries a 30-millimeter worktop with a white ESD-dissipative laminate.

text: Below, a lower shelf in the same laminate, its edge protected by a stainless steel angle.
On the left, a two-level stainless steel cart brings material in, and takes it back when the check is done.
Beside it, a black E S D bin for waste, with a push lid.
asr: Beside it, a black ESD bin for waste, with a push lid.

text: The L E D panel reaches seven hundred millimeters forward, on angled brackets, lighting the whole worktop.
asr: The LED panel reaches 700mm forward on angled brackets lighting the whole worktop.

text: At the left rear corner, an eight-times E S D magnifying lamp swings over the center, for close visual checks.
asr: At the left rear corner, an 8 times ESD magnifying lamp swings over the center, for close visual checks.

text: Above, a full-length cabinet, with one wide door and a key lock, keeps the measuring tools secure.
Inside: digital verniers, a micrometer on its stand, a thickness gauge, a tape measure, and a steel ruler.
Along the back, a four-outlet power rail.
On the right side, a notebook computer.
Two blue E S D chairs, with foot rings and casters, seat one or two operators.
asr: Two blue ESD chairs, with foot rings and casters, seat one or two operators.

text: One location. Everything the inspector needs, within reach.
